description: Use when a user asks how much to spend on the holidays or on Christmas gifts, e.g. "how much should I budget for Christmas?", "can I afford $50 gifts for 8 people?" or "how much do I need to save each week for the holidays?". Adds gifts (people x budget per person), travel, food and decor; returns the total, its share of monthly take-home pay, weeks of saving needed, cash by the holidays and a spend limit (spend this, not more), plus the per-person gift budget that fits. Same math as the compoundmint.com holiday budget calculator. Educational only, not financial advice.

already_saved.description: USD already saved for the holidays (default 0).

decor.description: Decor, wrapping and cards in USD (default 0).

monthly_income.description: Monthly take-home pay in USD (optional, for the percent of income).

per_person_budget.description: Gift budget per person in USD.

weekly_savings.description: USD you can save each week (default 0).

weeks_left.description: Weeks until the holidays (default: full weeks until December 25).

name: calculate_holiday_budget
title: Holiday budget calculator
